messages:
Jamal: Quick follow-up from the token-validation incident — want to align on remediation ownership, timelines, and a recurring checks plan. TL;DR: rotation, perms audit, audit-log gap.
Sarah K.: I can own token rotation. Plan: rotate service account tokens, validate clients, then update rotation automation. Target: 3 business days. @sec-bot please create SEC ticket. :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-789: 'service-token rotation and validation' — assignee: Sarah K. — priority: high — link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-789
Alex P.: I'll take permissions audit. I'll run a quick `role:count` across prod and flag any roles with >10 principals. Deliverable: PR with remediations + test plan in 7 days.
Maria L.: I'll investigate the missing audit events for the token refresh endpoint. I suspect a filter on the log-forwarder dropped `token.refresh` events. I'll spin up temporary verbose logging and replay yesterday's request traces. ETA: 48 hours for root cause + mitigation.
Jamal: Good. For rotation, Sarah — can you add a small runbook snippet so oncall can validate? Example commands below.
Sarah K.: Added draft runbook in SEC-789 comments. Quick validation command: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEW" https://auth.redwood.internal/v1/introspect | jq .active` — expecting `true` for new tokens and `false` for old.
Alex P.: Perms audit notes: will start with these queries: `gcloud iam roles list --project=redwood-prod` and `kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | jq '.subjects'` — will post results to ENG-3456.
Maria L.: For logs I'll add a short-lived config: ```
# prod-log-collector override
filters:
  include:
    - event: token.refresh
    - level: info
```
Julian (infra): Heads-up — if we enable verbose logging for 48h, watch disk IO on the log-shipper nodes. I'll put autoscale rules in place and a 24h alert for log volume.
Dara: Recurring checks suggestion: weekly token validation smoke (simple token exchange + introspect), monthly permissions diff (baseline vs current), and daily audit-log ingestion healthcheck. I can own the scheduler for the smoke checks.
Jamal: Agree on schedule. Action items summary: Sarah -> SEC-789 rotation (3d), Alex -> ENG-3456 perms audit (7d), Maria -> audit-log root cause + mitigation (48h), Julian -> infra safety for verbose logging (now), Dara -> schedule recurring smoke checks (weekly). I'll update the postmortem follow-up doc with these owners and dates.
Sarah K.: Quick Q — for rotation, do we rotate all service accounts or start with critical autop-runner accounts? Suggest start critical-only, then sweep. :thinking:
Alex P.: +1 start critical-only (autop-runner, infra-deploy, billing). Document the sweep plan in PR.
Jamal: Good call. We'll do critical-only first, mark result, then schedule sweep. If anyone hits blockers ping me or page oncall. :eyes:
sec-bot: Reminder: schedule follow-up review meeting in 3 business days for SEC-789 — suggested attendees: Jamal, Sarah K., Alex P., Maria L., Dara.
Maria L.: I'll paste any log samples and the quick mitigation steps into SEC-789 when ready.
Dara: I'll create a recurring Trello checklist item for the weekly smoke and link it in the follow-up doc.
Jamal: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in the follow-up meeting; this thread will be the single source of truth for owners/timelines.
